meta.title: Pulse
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app: source/README.md, its design tokens (src/index.css in the app repository) and its captured screens. Light brushed-aluminium panels, near-black ink, one hot orange; numbers and level meters like an instrument panel; the chrome X is the app's own ChromeBlob SVG, captured.

source.notes: a small, sharp dashboard for makers: gauges, due radar, heatmap, rings, release log, quick-add syntax, command palette
the real app (its production build, served locally) captured by capture/app.json; projects, to-dos and releases are the app's own fictional sample data
Pretendard Variable (the app's face) and JetBrains Mono (labels); SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: The app's light tokens: aluminium bg #E9EAEE / #DFE1E6, panels #F4F5F7, ink #0D0E11 / #30333A / #555963, and the single hot orange #F05A28 it uses for what needs attention (overdue counts, the add button, the live dot). Its status colours stay where status is meant: ok green #0E9F6E, info blue #1A44C4, warn #D9A400, danger #D12F2F.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable at 900 for the big numbers and headlines with tight tracking, as the app sets '오늘의 계기판'; monospaced capitals for the labels the app stamps everywhere ('PULSE · 2026.10.12 MON · W42', 'QUICK ADD', 'DUE RADAR').
rationale.motion: Mechanical and exact: parts snap into slots with a short overshoot, needles and level meters jump to their value and settle, a tick ruler runs along the panel. The meters pulse on the beat, so the reel itself has a pulse; holds keep a scanning line and meter flicker alive.
rationale.sound: Bright pop at 112 BPM in G major (7 bars in 15 s, 14 in 30 s): a clean, confident groove for a light, orderly tool, with digital SFX (ticks for typed tokens, blips for parsed chips, counts for the numbers).
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: the chrome X spins in as the name lands; one typed line split into title, priority, project and due date by the app's own parser; the real gauges and panels assembling into today's instrument panel; the end card. The 30 s cut adds the command palette and the release log with its next-version suggestion.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, muted launch reel with slogan-length Korean copy shown as type.
